usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start          \"Query embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                query_vec.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.chunks_index {\n            // Search the index - SearchResults doesn't implement map_err as it's not a Result\n            let results = index.search(query_vec, k);\n\n            // .zip(results.scores.iter())\n                .filter_map(|(idx, score)| {\n                    if *idx < 0 {\n                        return None;\n                    }\n                    self.chunks_id_map\n                        .index_to_id\n                        .get(&(*idx as usize))\n                        .cloned()\n                        .map(|id| (id, *score))\n                })\n                .collect();\n\n            Ok(converted)\n        } else {\n            Ok(Vec::new())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of sessions in the index\n    pub fn tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn with role prefixes to create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn Feature-gated behind the `[vector] enabled = true` configuration option.\n//!\n//! ---\n//!\n//! **Current stub behavior:**\n//!\n//! - All methods succeed without error\n//! - `upsert_session()` and `upsert_chunk()` store IDs only (no real embeddings)\n//! - `search_sessions()` and `search_chunks()` return empty results\n//! - `is_functional()` returns false\n//! - Index files are created but contain no real vector data\n\nuse crate::config::VectorConfig;\nuse crate::error::{AgentScribeError, Result};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n// turbovec::TurboQuantIndex temporarily disabled due to BLAS linking issues\n// use turbovec::TurboQuantIndex;\n\n/// Filename for the session-level vector index\nconst SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE: &str = \"sessions.tvim\";\n\n/// Filename for the chunk-level vector index\nconst CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE: &str = \"chunks.tvim\";\n\n/// Filename for the ID-to-index mapping\nconst ID_MAP_FILE: &str = \"id_map.json\";\n\n/// Vector index state tracking\n///\n/// Tracks which session IDs have been embedded, allowing incremental updates\n/// and recovery after interruptions. Maps to `state/embed-state.json`.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]\npub struct EmbedState {\n    /// Set of session IDs that have been embedded at the session level\n Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl EmbedState {\n    /// Check if a session has been embedded\n    pub fn is_session_embedded(&self, session_id: &str) -> bool {\n        self.embedded_sessions.contains(&session_id.to_string())\n    }\n\n    /// Check if a chunk has been embedded\n    pub fn is_chunk_embedded(&self, chunk_id: &str) -> bool {\n        self.embedded_chunks.contains(&chunk_id.to_string())\n    }\n\n    /// Mark a session as embedded\n    pub fn mark_session_embedded(&mut self, session_id: String) {\n        if !self.is_session_embedded(&session_id) {\n            self.embedded_sessions.push(session_id);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Mark a chunk as embedded\n    pub fn mark_chunk_embedded(&mut self, chunk_id: String) {\n        if !self.is_chunk_embedded(&chunk_id) {\n            self.embedded_chunks.push(chunk_id);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Load embed state from file\n    pub fn load(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(EmbedState::default());\n        }\n\n        let content = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                \"Failed to read embed state from {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                \"Failed to parse embed state from {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Save embed state to file\n    pub fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                    \"Failed to create embed state directory: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n\n        let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\"Failed to serialize embed state: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n\n        fs::write(path, content).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                \"Failed to write embed state to {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// ID mapping for vector index\n///\n/// Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]\nstruct IdMap {\n    /// Maps string ID to vector index in the flat array\n    id_to_index: HashMap<String, usize>,\n    /// Maps vector index back to string create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn Feature-gated behind the `[vector] enabled = true` configuration option.\n//!\n//! ---\n//!\n//! **Current stub behavior:**\n//!\n//! - All methods succeed without error\n//! - `upsert_session()` and `upsert_chunk()` store IDs only (no real embeddings)\n//! - `search_sessions()` and `search_chunks()` return empty results\n//! - `is_functional()` returns false\n//! - Index files are created but contain no real vector data\n\nuse crate::config::VectorConfig;\nuse crate::error::{AgentScribeError, Result};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n// turbovec::TurboQuantIndex temporarily disabled due to BLAS linking issues\n// use turbovec::TurboQuantIndex;\n\n/// Filename for the session-level vector index\nconst SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE: &str = \"sessions.tvim\";\n\n/// Filename for the chunk-level vector index\nconst CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE: &str = \"chunks.tvim\";\n\n/// Filename for the ID-to-index mapping\nconst ID_MAP_FILE: &str = \"id_map.json\";\n\n/// Vector index state tracking\n///\n/// Tracks which session IDs have been embedded, allowing incremental updates\n/// and recovery after interruptions. Maps to `state/embed-state.json`.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]\npub struct EmbedState {\n    /// Set of session IDs that have been embedded at the session level\n Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl EmbedState {\n    /// Check if a session has been embedded\n    pub fn is_session_embedded(&self, session_id: &str) -> bool {\n        self.embedded_sessions.contains(&session_id.to_string())\n    }\n\n    /// Check if a chunk has been embedded\n    pub fn is_chunk_embedded(&self, chunk_id: &str) -> bool {\n        self.embedded_chunks.contains(&chunk_id.to_string())\n    }\n\n    /// Mark a session as embedded\n    pub fn mark_session_embedded(&mut self, session_id: String) {\n        if !self.is_session_embedded(&session_id) {\n            self.embedded_sessions.push(session_id);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Mark a chunk as embedded\n    pub fn mark_chunk_embedded(&mut self, chunk_id: String) {\n        if !self.is_chunk_embedded(&chunk_id) {\n            self.embedded_chunks.push(chunk_id);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Load embed state from file\n    pub fn load(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        if !path.exists() {\n            return Ok(EmbedState::default());\n        }\n\n        let content = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                \"Failed to read embed state from {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                \"Failed to parse embed state from {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Save embed state to file\n    pub fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                    \"Failed to create embed state directory: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n\n        let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\"Failed to serialize embed state: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n\n        fs::write(path, content).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::State(format!(\n                \"Failed to write embed state to {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// ID mapping for vector index\n///\n/// Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]\nstruct IdMap {\n    /// Maps string ID to vector index in the flat array\n    id_to_index: HashMap<String, usize>,\n    /// Maps vector index back to string create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn
